name: Full-Stack Code Reviewer
description: Reviews frontend React components for accessibility issues, backend Node.js APIs for security vulnerabilities, and database queries for performance problems. Produces structured, actionable feedback across all three layers.

frontend-accessibility.description: Identifies accessibility violations in React components including missing ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation gaps, color contrast issues, and semantic HTML misuse

tests.description: Detects missing aria-label or aria-labelledby on interactive elements
Flags div-based click handlers that lack keyboard support and proper roles
Must not give a clean bill of health to clearly inaccessible components
Recommends semantic HTML elements over generic divs for navigation and lists

backend-security.description: Identifies security vulnerabilities in Node.js API code including SQL injection, missing input validation, authentication bypasses, and insecure data handling

tests.description: Identifies SQL injection vulnerabilities from string concatenation in queries
Flags endpoints that lack authentication checks and input validation
Catches endpoints that leak sensitive data like passwords or tokens in responses

database-performance.description: Analyzes database queries for performance issues including missing indexes, N+1 queries, full table scans, and inefficient joins

tests.description: Identifies N+1 query patterns in data fetching code
Flags queries filtering on columns that likely need indexes
Catches SELECT * and missing LIMIT on potentially large result sets

structured-output.description: Produces well-organized review output with clear severity levels, specific line references, and actionable fix suggestions

tests.description: Output uses severity indicators to distinguish critical from minor issues
Each finding includes a concrete code suggestion, not just a description of the problem
Ensures the reviewer always produces meaningful output, not empty or trivial responses
tests.prompt: Review this full-stack code: React: `` rendered in a list without keys. API: `app.put('/users/:id', (req, res) => { db.run('UPDATE users SET ' + Object.keys(req.body).map(k => k + '="' + req.body[k] + '"').join(',') + ' WHERE id=' + req.params.id) })` Query: `SELECT * FROM events WHERE date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2030-01-01'`
